meta.reset: Reset DB, cache and search index to `fixtures` before every case. Languages and categories are loaded from fixtures.languages and fixtures.categories. Actor rows are seeded by the harness (email <name>@example.com, last_login null, permissions = session mask). Inject sessions directly.
meta.actor: Key into fixtures.actors, or: anonymous (no Authorization header), garbage_session, expired_session. Actor mask = actor.permissions when non-zero, else derived from categories_caps (create/edit/delete bits for the categories module).
meta.request: path_params are unescaped and must be percent-encoded when substituted. headers: null removes a default header. body_raw (even empty string) overrides body. body_generator {json_padded_bytes: N, base} = valid JSON of exactly N bytes, padded with an unknown field.
meta.tokens: {$const: NAME} constants; {$repeat: {s, n}}; {$email_of_length: N}; {$raw_session: actor} session id without Bearer; {$actor_perms: actor} the actor's permission mask. Tokens appear only as direct field values (body, headers, path_params, assertion value).
meta.json_assertions: List of {path, op, value}. ops: eq, ne, type, len_eq, len_lte, gte, includes, excludes, is_null, not_null, unix_or_null, sorted_asc, sorted_desc. Paths with [*] resolve to lists.
meta.eventually_ms: Retry the step until it passes or the timeout elapses (indexing is async).
meta.note: Free-text explanation of the assumption behind a case.
meta.source: documented = rules inside the source_document (or languages.md for cross-module cases); stated = general rules you gave outside the docs (406/413/415); inferred = derived from code (strings.go) or conventions.
meta.tags: boundary, cache, security, regression, verify_normalisation (needs case-folding), verify_char_counting (limits counted in characters, code counts bytes for slug only because it is ASCII), verify_clamp (ClampParams behaviour), assumes_distinct_bits (create/edit/delete are separate bits), undocumented_limit (limit comes from strings.go, not from the docs).
